sql: SELECT ADDRESS,MIN(ROUTE_ORD)ORD,COUNT(*)CNT,COUNT(ROUTE_ORD)ORD_COUNT,MIN(ROUTE_ORD)LO,MAX(ROUTE_ORD)HI FROM JSON_TABLE(:B1 ,'$.members[*]'COLUMNS(ADDRESS VARCHAR2(200)PATH '$.address',ROUTE_ORD NUMBER PATH '$.route_ordinal')) GROUP BY ADDRESS ORDER BY MIN(ROUTE_ORD),ADDRESS

SELECT /*+ leading(p m) use_nl(m) index(m PK_DIST_MATRIX) */ P.POS,P.A,P.B,M.DURATION_MIN,M.DURATION_BASIS,M.SOURCE,M.UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN M.UPDATED_AT>=SYSDATE-1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FRESH FROM JSON_TABLE(:B1 ,'$[*]'COLUMNS(POS FOR ORDINALITY,A VARCHAR2(200)PATH '$.from_address',B VARCHAR2(200)PATH '$.to_address'))P LEFT JOIN RRL_ADDR_DISTANCE_MATRIX M ON M.FROM_ADDR=P.A AND M.TO_ADDR=P.B ORDER BY P.POS

SELECT P.POS,P.A,P.B,M.DURATION_MIN,M.DURATION_BASIS,M.SOURCE,M.UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN M.UPDATED_AT>=SYSDATE-1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FRESH FROM JSON_TABLE(:B1 ,'$[*]'COLUMNS(POS FOR ORDINALITY,A VARCHAR2(200)PATH '$.from_address',B VARCHAR2(200)PATH '$.to_address'))P LEFT JOIN RRL_ADDR_DISTANCE_MATRIX M ON M.FROM_ADDR=P.A AND M.TO_ADDR=P.B ORDER BY P.POS

SELECT T.ID,T.VODITEL_ID,A.SOURCE_HASH,A.RESULT_JSON FROM RRL_TRANSPORT_TASK T JOIN RRL_TT_TIME_APPROVAL A ON A.TT_ID=T.ID WHERE T.ID!=:B3 AND NVL(T.DELETED,0)=0 AND T.CONDITION='Спланирован'AND NVL(T.PAY_ORDER_ID,0)=0 AND(T.TRANSPORT=:B2 OR T.VODITEL_ID=:B1 ) AND A.VERSION_NO=(SELECT MAX(LATEST.VERSION_NO)FROM RRL_TT_TIME_APPROVAL LATEST WHERE LATEST.TT_ID=T.ID) ORDER BY T.ID FETCH FIRST 201 ROWS ONLY
